name: W12_methods_compared

provenance.source: The Gödel Method: Research and Development Handover (2026-10-22), W-12

statement: Three ways to decide that the constraints equal the terms: exhaustive evaluation (proof over a finite domain; 345.9 s for the outputs with at most 16 input bits, and it cannot reach wider ones), SMT (proof by a decision procedure; 1.7 s for all 1075), and the Schwartz-Zippel trace identity (probabilistic proof with error 2N/p, one check per instruction, the basis of succinct proofs that code ran correctly).
